autoPromotionRules.note: requiresCompleteJudgmentMetadata mirrors judgmentRecord.js's own mechanically-enforced invariant (autoPromotionEligible is forced false whenever model/reasoningConfig/calibrationCorpusVersion is null) -- this policy document and that code must never disagree, which is why the invariant lives in code, not just here. newTemplateClassesRequireManualPromotion is why Phase 6 Task 8 manually promotes the breakout item even though no automated check currently blocks it -- the breakout family (dz_breakout) has zero calibrated decisions yet, so the calibration bar alone already makes it ineligible; this rule makes the same conclusion explicit and permanent for any future first-of-a-class item, not just implied by an empty calibration corpus.
